answer_text: A chain-of-thought (CoT) exemplar provides the model with a step‑by‑step reasoning trace that it can mimic when generating its own answer. First, the prompt includes a question and a detailed reasoning chain ending in the correct answer. The model then sees this pattern and, for a new question, reproduces a similar chain of intermediate thoughts before outputting the final answer, improving accuracy on complex tasks.

components.title: Flow of Chain‑of‑Thought Prompting
components.reason: A diagram clarifies the sequence from exemplar to model reasoning to final answer.
